name: entrepreneurship
description: People work or open firms; firms earn or lose money and pay dividends to their owners; a central bank moves the interest rate toward a target number of firms per person. Nothing here is known to the engine: it is all schema, data and scripts.

interestRate.description: Base interest rate (yearly), set by the central bank

businessCost.description: Capital needed to open a firm

wealth.description: Cash. Spending more than this is rejected by the engine

knowledge.description: Business knowledge; raises the chance a venture works

ventures.description: Outcome of this person's last ventures

aggressiveness.description: How strongly the bank reacts to deviations from its target

target.description: Firms per person the bank aims for. Private: other agents do not know it

open_business.description: Pay the business cost up front; with luck and knowledge a firm is born.
open_business.propensity: 0.3 * sigmoid(-4 + 3 * knowledge + 3 * riskTolerance - 20 * ctx.interestRate + 2 * (ctx.demand - 1) - count("ventures", false))

rules.name: operate
rules.description: Each firm earns or loses money, pays dividends, or closes
